candidates.meaning: List drugs and their effects in order of their popularity in prescriptions
candidates.sql: SELECT D.name, E.effectText FROM Drug D JOIN Prescription P ON D.drugID = P.drugID JOIN Side_Effects SE ON D.sideEffectID = SE.sideEffectID JOIN Effectiveness E ON D.effectivenessID = E.effectivenessID GROUP BY D.name, E.effectText ORDER BY COUNT(P.prescriptionID) DESC

candidates.meaning: List drugs and their effects in order of the total quantity prescribed.
candidates.sql: SELECT D.name, E.effectText FROM Drug D JOIN Prescription P ON D.drugID = P.drugID JOIN Side_Effects E ON D.sideEffectID = E.sideEffectID GROUP BY D.name, E.effectText ORDER BY SUM(P.quantity) DESC

candidates.meaning: List drugs and their primary effects in order of the total quantity prescribed, ignoring side effects.
candidates.sql: SELECT D.name, E.effectText FROM Drug D JOIN Prescription P ON D.drugID = P.drugID JOIN Effectiveness E ON D.effectivenessID = E.effectivenessID GROUP BY D.name, E.effectText ORDER BY SUM(P.quantity) DESC

candidates.meaning: List drugs and their primary effects in order of the total number of prescriptions written, ignoring the quantity prescribed.
candidates.sql: SELECT D.name, E.effectText FROM Drug D JOIN Prescription P ON D.drugID = P.drugID JOIN Effectiveness E ON D.effectivenessID = E.effectivenessID GROUP BY D.name, E.effectText ORDER BY COUNT(P.prescriptionID) DESC
